description: Complete 3-row import with one guardian, phone and pickup schedule per child; small execution-growth point. Newly inserted guardian profiles are passed to the link command in the same transaction instead of being read again. Newly created children also carry the enrollment command result to the link, avoiding the repeated child read while its insert remains protected by the same transaction. The first phone of a newly created guardian uses the same-transaction create fact instead of re-reading the empty phone list, count and maximum priority; later phones and reused guardians retain the read. Each phone add reads the complete guardian profile under its existing row lock in one statement instead of locking and reading separately. Non-primary guardian links clear retention and insert the relationship in one dependent statement, preserving the guardian row lock and unconditional retention write. The batch path writes each row without a row savepoint, because a failed row aborts its whole chunk (#5552, ADR 0067 addendum step 3).
